The page names two forthcoming volumes under Pursuing Stacks, with the first volume subtitled The Modelizing Story, including the visible comma. It describes a synthesis of homotopical algebra, (co)homological algebra and topos theory, ripe for more than fifteen years but never yet begun.

The final paragraph places the two volumes in a wider series Réflexions Mathématiques and mentions naive ideas about two new continents. It stops at One stems from. The page gives no date or page count; 9 is an archive corner number, not an authorial page number.
